# PANDA COLLECTIONS (PANDATEC PTE. LTD.)

> Singapore-based B2B supply chain and procurement partner. PANDA COLLECTIONS is the brand of PANDATEC PTE. LTD. (UEN 201541665H), supplying 1670 catalogued products for offices, hotels, schools, hospitals, cleanrooms, warehouses, factories and corporate gifting in Singapore. Prices are quoted on request.

- Address: 35 Tannery Road #05-06, Ruby Industrial Complex, Singapore 347740
- Phone / WhatsApp: +65 8472 6456
- Email: info@pandatec.sg
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM
- Request a quote: https://pandatecsg.github.io/pandatec-website/request-a-quote/

Every product page lists the product code (PT-…), category path, material, dimensions, minimum order and FAQs, with schema.org Product markup.
